title: Multi-Site runtime lookup index for Sites list
opportunity: GET /api/sites scanned the active runtime Site list with FirstOrDefault for every persisted Site, producing O(N^2) matching work as the number of Sites grew.
implementation: Built one case-insensitive runtime Site dictionary per list request.
Replaced nested active-runtime scans with O(1) dictionary lookups while preserving pending-restart and active response semantics.
Added a regression contract that rejects the nested scan and requires the indexed lookup.

verification.broadRegression: 468/595 passed; 127 failed because PostgreSQL was unavailable at 127.0.0.1:5432 in this environment; no failure was attributed to the indexed lookup

boundary: Large live PostgreSQL Site-list latency benchmark
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
